FULL TEXT:
i
ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for the following posts purely on CONTRACT BASIS for a duration
of Six months only in a SIA project entitled “Social Impact Assessment Study for
Acquisition of Land for constructing Dashmesh Canal in 58 villages of Districts
Rupnagar, Patiala, SAS Nagar Mohali (61.433Kms) under section 4.1 of Right to Fair
Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement
Act (RFCTLARR)-2013”. The interested candidates can attend the walk-in interviews, along
with their detailed bio-data and attested copies of requisite qualification certificates and work
experience, in the office of the undersigned on 24.12.2024 at 10.30 am
(i) Research Investigator (04): Four posts for 06 months only (on contract basis)
Essential qualifications:
i) Postgraduate in Anthropology or allied social sciences subjects with minimum 55% marks
for the General category candidates (& 50% in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii) The age of the candidate should be below 40 years
Desirable qualifications:
i) The candidate should possess knowledge of fieldwork and must be willing to conduct
independent fieldwork/data collection.
ii) Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of the Punjabi language.
Emoluments: Rs. 36,000/- per month (consolidated)
No T.A./D.A. is permissible for appearing in the interview.
(ii) Field Assistant (03): Three posts for 06 months only (on contract basis)
Essential qualifications:
i) Graduate in Anthropology or allied social sciences subjects with minimum 55% marks for
General category candidates (50% in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii) The age of the candidate should be below 40 years
iii) The candidate should possess knowledge of fieldwork and must be willing to conduct
independent fieldwork/data collection.
Desirable qualifications:
Preference will be given to candidates having knowledge of the Punjabi language.
Emoluments: Rs. 25,000/- per month (consolidated)
ii
iii) Helper (01): One post for entire project duration of Six months (on hiring basis)
Emoluments: Rs. 50,000/- consolidated amount to be paid for entire project duration of Six
months
Essential qualifications:
i) Matriculate for General category candidates (Middle pass in case of SC/ST candidates)
ii) The age of the candidate should be below 50 years
iii) Physically sound to accompany the SIA team in the field
Note: Please check the department website before appearing for the interview; as there might
be a possibility of a change in the date and time of the interviews.
Dr. JS Sehrawat
Assistant Professor & Principal Consultant
Department of Anthropology
Panjab University
Chandigarh-160014
